entry.title: PotentialHeat 1.6.0
entry.summary: **PotentialHeat 1.6.0** - New **Hi-Fi** look (the fifth on the LOOK selector, from PotentialBox): walnut cheeks, a brushed charcoal faceplate, raised panels, domed knobs lit in the plugin's colour, moulded cream keys and green glass displays. - The LOOK selector now has five looks: Print Plate, Night Rack, Colour Block, Vintage and Hi-Fi.

entry.title: PotentialHeat 1.5.1
entry.summary: **PotentialHeat 1.5.1** - **Lighter on the CPU, same sound.** The 2x oversampling filters now use the filter's symmetry (each pair of mirrored taps shares one multiply) and read their history in one straight run. In a 60-second test over every CHARACTER and drive it did about 31% less work, with 99.8% of output samples identical and the rest within the smallest possible step (1 bit of 16).

entry.title: PotentialHeat 1.5.0
entry.summary: **PotentialHeat 1.5.0** - **A fourth look: Vintage.** A late-80s drum machine: warm grey panel, cream keys with a hard shadow, an amber display, and PotentialHeat's own colour for what's selected. It is Potential1200's look, now in the whole PotentialSuite. Pick it with the LOOK keys on the SETTINGS (or SETUP) page; Print Plate stays the default.

entry.title: PotentialHeat 1.4.0
entry.summary: **PotentialHeat 1.4.0** - **USER presets.** A new USER page with 8 slots: tap **SAVE**, then a slot, to keep the sound you have now; tap a slot to bring it back. Filled slots read USER 1 to USER 8, empty ones EMPTY, and the slot you loaded last is lit. entry.title: PotentialHeat 1.3.0
entry.summary: **PotentialHeat 1.3.0** - **LEVEL MATCH now measures.** It compares how loud the sound is going in and coming out (over about a second) and turns the processed sound down by the difference, so louder never just sounds better. Before, it guessed from DRIVE alone. Projects with LEVEL MATCH on will now sit at the same loudness as the dry sound. - **Drum-bus pair presets**: Boom Bap Bus, Lo-Fi Bus, Modern Bus and Glue Bus. entry.title: PotentialHeat 1.2.0
entry.summary: **PotentialHeat 1.2.0** - **ROLL**: one tap for a random setting that still sounds good: drive, character, tone, ceiling and mix. **MILD**, **MEDIUM** or **WILD** under it sets how far it goes (MILD stays gentle, WILD pushes hard). LEVEL MATCH is kept on and OUTPUT at 0 dB, so a roll never jumps in volume. Keep rolling until you like it, then fine-tune. - The preset keys are a little narrower to make room for it. entry.title: PotentialHeat 1.1.1
entry.summary: **PotentialHeat 1.1.1** - **Ready for MPC OS 3.10.1's plugin folders.** Every download now carries the `plugin.json` that MPC OS 3.10.1 looks for, so the plugin folder can be copied by hand straight into `VST2 Plugins`. - **Gen2 MPCs in the Open MPC catalog.** A separate 64-bit download (`-mpc-aarch64.zip`), so the Plugin Manager can install it on Gen2 MPCs, and the catalog's 3.10.1 download (`-mpc-sdk.zip`). - Built with the current Open MPC kit. Sound, controls and saved projects are unchanged

entry.title: PotentialHeat 1.1.0
entry.summary: **PotentialHeat 1.1.0** - **Three looks.** A new default look, **Print Plate** (a warm printed panel), plus **Night Rack** (dark rack unit) and **Colour Block** (flat, big type), each in PotentialHeat's own colour. Pick one with the big LOOK keys on the SETTINGS page; it shows the next time the plugin loads (take it off and add it again, or load your project again), and it is remembered on your MPC for every project. - Sound, controls and saved projects are unchanged.
